storage: Real local SQLite FTS5, production writeMemory and performAutoRecall
queriesPerGroup: Each stored state, in actual observed FTS rank order, plus missing context
oracle: Exact expected memory ID from the explicit execution coordinate; no LLM Judge
timing: One warm-up per SQLite database, then wall time around production recall; tokenizer excluded
boundary: Controlled rank-pressure diagnostic, not a held-out general coding-agent or natural-language extraction evaluation. Outside-pool cases are reported, not counted as successful recall. No tuning based on LLM answers.
